caption: sky note: "the feb 6 eclipse erases your karmic debt." not true. it's an annular solar eclipse in aquarius, and it's a reading, not a refund.

slides.headline: “your *300-year* karmic debt is erased at the eclipse.” *checked*
slides.dek: the eclipse is real. the debt relief isn't

slides.headline: “the eclipse wipes your karma clean. miss it and it's bad luck”
slides.body: there's no ephemeris for karma, and no eclipse is a 300-year event: solar eclipses happen somewhere on earth a few times a year. missing it changes nothing.

slides.headline: an *annular* eclipse: a ring, not a blackout
slides.body: the new moon crosses the sun but looks a little too small to cover it, so a ring of sun stays lit. never look at it without eclipse glasses.

slides.headline: eclipses read as *doors*, not debts
slides.body: astrologers read a solar eclipse as a stronger new moon: a start you didn't fully plan.

slides.headline: nobody's *erasing* anything. you can still apologise.
slides.body: the eclipse won't fix it. a clear, kind text might.
